title: The Earth Experience
body:
# Welcome to The Earth Experience 🌍

This is the official modpack built around the Tellus Mod, designed to give you a truly immersive and breathtaking world. Alongside Tellus, you’ll find a carefully selected set of mods that enhance realism, scale, and overall exploration making your journey feel much closer to the real Earth.

# Tips
Use a -**2000 blocks height offset** so large mountain ranges don’t get cut off by the height limit (**2032 blocks**).
It’s best to keep Mount Everest at **1:3** scale or lower for optimal performance and terrain generation.

# [System Configs/Specs]
Minium : 
- Intel Core i5 11600k / AMD Ryzen 5 7600X
- GTX 1080 - 1650 / Intel Arc A380 / AMD RX 580
- 8GB DDR5 RAM
- 1-2TB Storage

Reccomended : 
- Intel I7-13700K / AMD Ryzen 7 - 9 
- RTX 4060 / AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT / Intel Arc A770
- 16GB/32GB/64GB DDR5 RAM
- 1-2TB Storage
